sloka: प्रत्यगात्ममिमं धर्मं सत्यं पश्याम्यहं स्वयम् ।भार: सत्पुरुषाचीर्णस्तदर्थमभिमन्यते ॥ २.१०९.१९॥
transliteration: pratyagātmamimaṁ dharmaṁ satyaṁ paśyāmyahaṁ svayam ।bhāra: satpuruṣācīrṇastadarthamabhimanyate ॥ 2.109.19॥

translations.english: I personally regard this righteousness practised by the virtuous as an evident form of truth, as the supreme self. Therefore, this burden (difficult task of living as an exile) is gratifying to me.
